key.name: alarms
key.description: Alarms as (id, hour, minute, weekday mask starting from Monday, label, enabled); a zero mask rings once.

key.name: alarm-actions
key.description: Alarms that start another app instead of ringing, as alarm id mapped to (application id, action name, string parameter). The action is activated through org.freedesktop.Application; if that fails the alarm rings as usual.

key.name: skipped-alarms
key.description: Alarms whose next ring is skipped, as alarm id mapped to the Unix time of the skipped ring.

key.name: world-clocks
key.description: Time zone identifiers shown in the World view.

key.name: snooze-minutes
key.description: Minutes an alarm waits before ringing again after Snooze.

key.name: ring-minutes
key.description: Minutes an alarm or timer keeps ringing before it stops on its own.

key.name: timer-seconds
key.description: Duration of the last timer, in seconds.

key.name: pomodoro-focus-minutes
key.description: Minutes of each Pomodoro focus session.

key.name: pomodoro-short-break-minutes
key.description: Minutes of the break after a focus session.

key.name: pomodoro-long-break-minutes
key.description: Minutes of the break after every fourth focus session.

key.name: last-view
key.description: The view shown when Clock was last used.
